churn_resistance.rationale: Data access, config, and routing are each centralized with types at boundaries, so a framework upgrade touches few files. A handful of local duplications (title logic, view mirror, non-chain resource coupling) would need cleanup before they multiply.

findings.issue: moveTables resource reads this.base.hasValue()/this.base.value()! directly inside params and the loader instead of the chain() helper, which the official resource docs explicitly recommend for dependent resources (correct loading/error propagation); the non-null assertion in the loader is fragile on races
findings.suggestion: Use params: ({chain}) => chain(this.base) && { game: this.selectedGame() } (or extract pokemon from the chained value) so moveTables mirrors base's loading/error states

findings.issue: Promise cache ignores the resource abortSignal; resource loaders never pass abortSignal, so rapid filter changes on the home page fan out 48 pokemon fetches with no cancellation path
findings.suggestion: Accept and forward an AbortSignal from loaders (or return the raw fetch promise where possible); at minimum document that the cache makes abort a no-op

findings.issue: Hand-rolled #moves scroll with setTimeout + document.getElementById instead of the router's built-in anchor scrolling
findings.suggestion: Add withInMemoryScrolling({ anchorScrolling: 'enabled' }) to provideRouter and delete the effect

findings.issue: @angular/forms is a declared dependency but nothing in src/ imports it
findings.suggestion: Remove @angular/forms from dependencies; native form controls suffice here

findings.issue: Resource value mirrored into a separate view signal via effect to keep the last resolved page during reloads — duplicated state that can drift from the resource's own status
findings.suggestion: Render data.value() with hasValue() guards, or use the documented resourceFromSnapshots/linkedSignal keep-previous composition once it stabilizes

findings.issue: Sort click handlers are duplicated on both the <th> and the inner <button>
findings.suggestion: Keep the handler only on the button; the header cell is already covered by its child

findings.issue: The '<name> – Pokédex' title-setting effect is copy-pasted across five page components
findings.suggestion: Extract a small setDexTitle(name) helper (or route-level title resolver support) into core/helpers

summary: This is a current-generation Angular 22 app: the new @Service() decorator, stable resource() for all data loading, signal inputs, lazy standalone routes, and withComponentInputBinding for URL state, with zero legacy-era APIs anywhere. Dependencies are lean and the platform is used well (native form controls, CSS custom properties/grid, fetch-backed HttpClient), though router anchor scrolling and request aborts are hand-rolled. Data access, typing, and runtime config are each centralized in one place, so upgrades would touch few files; only minor local duplication (title effects, the home-page view mirror, the non-chain resource coupling) would need cleanup.
